integrity: The proof uses the source's explicit rational formula, an exact boundary real-part reduction, monotonicity in \(\operatorname{Re}w\), a partial-fraction control of the exceptional boundary pole, and the harmonic minimum principle. Outside \([0,1]\), failure is certified by an interior pole or an explicit negative boundary value with interior continuity. Numerical evaluations are consistency checks only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is exact for the canonical convex half-plane family and its rotations, not for every normalized convex function. It confirms the source's pointwise positivity conjecture on this family and identifies the exact uniform floor, while showing that the source's positive-minimum formulation fails at the endpoint \(\alpha=1\). The main pointwise conjecture remains open in general.
title: Exact positivity interval for the canonical half-plane Carathéodory component
